title: Same sign or opposite signs?
text: Adding a positive number moves right. You start at $$-8$$ and move 15 units right. A common mistake is to add the absolute values and keep the negative sign. Which way does $$+15$$ move you?

title: How far past zero?
text: The first 8 units of the move cancel the debt of 8 and land on 0. The remaining distance is $$15 - 8$$. What is $$15 - 8$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$-8 + 15 = 7$$. You move from $$-8$$ through 0 and 7 units into the positives. Common mistake: computing $$-(8 + 15) = -23$$. General rule: to add numbers with opposite signs, subtract the smaller absolute value from the larger one and keep the sign of the number with the larger absolute value.
